<!-- Thanks for contributing to llm-interview-prep. -->

## What this PR changes

- [ ] New question(s)
- [ ] Fix to an existing answer
- [ ] Resource / reference addition or update
- [ ] Tooling / CI
- [ ] Study plan / docs / wording

## For each new or changed Q&A entry

- [ ] The answer is correct to my best knowledge (I checked it, not just remembered it).
- [ ] The entry has a `**References.**` block with **at least one authoritative source** (the original paper, primary framework docs, or a widely-cited textbook) — OR the entry is a `coding` entry (with an `**Implementation.**` block) or a `behavioral` entry (with a `**Signal.**` block).
- [ ] I ran `python tools/validate_entries.py` and it passes.
- [ ] I ran `python tools/linkcheck.py` and any newly added link resolves.
- [ ] The `**Common mistakes.**` block names a real mistake a candidate would make — not boilerplate.

## Reviewer guide

Did you spot-check the answer against the cited reference? **Yes / No.**
If `No`, please do before approving — answer-correctness is this repo's non-negotiable quality gate.
